name: Able Sniper (Combat)
body:
You have trained at keeping hidden while sniping from afar.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Stealth 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on ranged attack rolls against flat-footed creatures that are a minimum of 30 feet away. Additionally, you gain a +4 bonus to Stealth checks made to hide again after you have made an ranged attack roll while hiding.
